tool_schemas.name: fda_drug_lookup
tool_schemas.description: Searches FDA drug label data for the given drug_name and returns up to max_results matching label records, while recording request/response metadata and incrementing per-session and global usage counters for the provided session_id (results are limited, not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if session_id does not match the required pattern, drug_name is missing/empty, or max_results is outside 1–100; raises NOT_FOUND when no matching labels are found. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the session is not permitted to use the service and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the session or global request limit is reached.

session_id.description: Session ULID used to attribute the request and update per-session usage.

drug_name.description: Drug name or brand/generic term to look up in FDA drug label data.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return.

session_id.description: Session ULID used to attribute the request and update per-session usage.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return.

date_range.description: Limit to articles published within the last N years.

tool_schemas.name: health_topics

Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if session_id is invalid, topic is missing/empty, or language is not one of en/es; raises NOT_FOUND when the topic cannot be found for the selected language. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the session is not permitted to use the service and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the session or global request limit is reached.

session_id.description: Session ULID used to attribute the request and update per-session usage.

topic.description: Health topic to retrieve evidence-based information for.

Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the session is not permitted to use the service and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the session or global request limit is reached.

session_id.description: Session ULID used to attribute the request and update per-session usage.

condition.description: Medical condition or disease to search for.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return.

tool_schemas.name: lookup_icd_code
tool_schemas.description: Looks up ICD-10 entries by exact code and/or by searching description text, returning up to max_results matching codes while recording request/response metadata and incrementing per-session and global usage counters for session_id (results are limited, not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if session_id is invalid, if neither code nor description is provided, or if max_results is outside 1–100; raises NOT_FOUND when no ICD-10 entries match the supplied criteria. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the session is not permitted to use the service and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the session or global request limit is reached.

session_id.description: Session ULID used to attribute the request and update per-session usage.

code.description: ICD-10 code to look up (optional if description is provided).

description.description: Medical condition description to search for (optional if code is provided).

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return.

tool_schemas.name: get_usage_stats
tool_schemas.description: Returns aggregated usage statistics for the specified session_id for the requested window (all_time or a single UTC day), including counts derived from the tracked tool calls for that session. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if session_id is invalid, if window is not one of the allowed values, or if window=day is provided without a valid day (YYYY-MM-DD); raises NOT_FOUND when the referenced session has no recorded usage for the requested window. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to access session usage statistics.

session_id.description: Session ULID to fetch usage statistics for.

window.description: Aggregation window for the returned usage stats.

day.description: UTC day (YYYY-MM-DD) to fetch when window is 'day'.

tool_schemas.name: get_all_usage_stats
tool_schemas.description: Returns aggregated usage statistics across all sessions for the requested window (all_time or a single UTC day), summarizing counts from tracked tool calls (no paging applies). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if window is not one of the allowed values or if window=day is provided without a valid day (YYYY-MM-DD). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to access global usage statistics.

window.description: Aggregation window for the returned usage stats.

day.description: UTC day (YYYY-MM-DD) to fetch when window is 'day'.

tool_schemas.name: create_session
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new session for a client and returns the session id to use with tool calls. The raw session token must never be stored; the service stores only a hash and rejects creation if expires_at is in the past.

client_id.description: Caller-provided client identifier used for attribution and observability.

session_token.description: Opaque session token presented by the caller; it is hashed server-side and never stored in raw form.

ip_address.description: Client IP address to associate with the session for audit/abuse detection.

user_agent.description: Client user-agent string to associate with the session.

expires_at.description: Optional UTC timestamp when the session should expire; if omitted the server applies its default TTL.

tool_schemas.name: get_session
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single session by id and returns its metadata and current lifecycle status. Refuses access if the caller is not entitled to view the session.
tool_schemas.implementation:
def get_session(session_id, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0466000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0466000") else "/app/database")

    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []

    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    def _now_iso():
        return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat()

    def _parse_dt(s):
        if s is None:
            return None
        if not isinstance(s, str) or not s:
            return None
        try:
            # Handles "...Z" and offsets
            if s.endswith("Z"):
                s = s[:-1] + "+00:00"
            return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s)
        except Exception:
            return None

    def _ulid_like(prefix, v):
        if not isinstance(v, str):
            return False
        pat = r"^" + re.escape(prefix) + r"_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{10,}$"
        return re.match(pat, v) is not None

    def _new_id(prefix):
        # ULID-like (Crockford base32), time-ordered enough for local use
        alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ"
        ms = int(time.time() * 1000)
        # 10 chars time part (base32-ish)
        t = ms
        out = []
        for _ in range(10):
            out.append(alphabet[t % 32])
            t //= 32
        out = list(reversed(out))
        # 16 chars randomness
        import random
        out.extend(alphabet[random.randrange(32)] for _ in range(16))
        return f"{prefix}_{''.join(out)}"

    def _resolve_active_session_for_ambient():
        # Ambient auth: choose a session that is eligible (active and not expired)
        sessions = _load("sessions.json")
        now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
        for s in sessions:
            if s.get("status") != "active":
                continue
            exp = _parse_dt(s.get("expires_at"))
            if exp is not None and exp <= now:
                continue
            return s
        return None

    def _log_tool_request(session_row, tool_name, input_params, status, http_status=None,
                          error_code=None, error_message=None, duration_ms=None, result_count=None,
                          cache_hit=False, normalized_cache_key=None):
        tool_requests = _load("tool_requests.json")
        now_iso = _now_iso()
        tr = {
            "id": _new_id("hcs_tr"),
            "session_id": session_row["id"],
            "tool_name": tool_name,
            "input_params": input_params if isinstance(input_params, dict) else {},
            "normalized_cache_key": normalized_cache_key,
            "status": status,
            "http_status": http_status,
            "error_code": error_code,
            "error_message": error_message,
            "duration_ms": duration_ms,
            "result_count": result_count,
            "cache_hit": bool(cache_hit),
            "created_at": now_iso,
            "updated_at": now_iso,
        }
        tool_requests.append(tr)
        _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)

        # Touch session last_seen_at/updated_at
        sessions = _load("sessions.json")
        for s in sessions:
            if s.get("id") == session_row["id"]:
                s["last_seen_at"] = now_iso
                s["updated_at"] = now_iso
                break
        _save("sessions.json", sessions)
        return tr

    def _inc_rollups(session_id, tool_name, terminal_status, cache_hit, duration_ms):
        usage = _load("usage_rollups.json")
        now_iso = _now_iso()

        def _find_or_create(scope, sid, tname):
            for r in usage:
                if r.get("scope") == scope and r.get("session_id") == sid and r.get("tool_name") == tname and r.get("window") == "all_time" and r.get("window_start") is None:
                    return r
            r = {
                "id": _new_id("hcs_ur"),
                "scope": scope,
                "session_id": sid,
                "tool_name": tname,
                "window": "all_time",
                "window_start": None,
                "request_count": 0,
                "success_count": 0,
                "error_count": 0,
                "cache_hit_count": 0,
                "upstream_call_count": 0,
                "total_duration_ms": 0,
                "created_at": now_iso,
                "updated_at": now_iso,
            }
            usage.append(r)
            return r

        dur = duration_ms if isinstance(duration_ms, int) and duration_ms >= 0 else 0
        hit = 1 if cache_hit else 0
        succ = 1 if terminal_status == "succeeded" else 0
        errc = 1 if terminal_status == "failed" else 0

        # session all tools
        r1 = _find_or_create("session", session_id, None)
        # session per tool
        r2 = _find_or_create("session", session_id, tool_name)
        # global all tools
        r3 = _find_or_create("global", None, None)
        # global per tool
        r4 = _find_or_create("global", None, tool_name)

        for r in (r1, r2, r3, r4):
            r["request_count"] += 1
            r["success_count"] += succ
            r["error_count"] += errc
            r["cache_hit_count"] += hit
            r["upstream_call_count"] += (1 - hit)
            r["total_duration_ms"] += dur
            r["updated_at"] = now_iso
            # keep invariants defensively
            if r["success_count"] + r["error_count"] > r["request_count"]:
                r["request_count"] = r["success_count"] + r["error_count"]
            if r["cache_hit_count"] > r["request_count"]:
                r["cache_hit_count"] = r["request_count"]
            if r["upstream_call_count"] < 0:
                r["upstream_call_count"] = 0
            if r["total_duration_ms"] < 0:
                r["total_duration_ms"] = 0

        _save("usage_rollups.json", usage)

    t0 = time.time()

    # Validate
    if not _ulid_like("hcs_sess", session_id):
        # Still log attempt if possible
        sess = _resolve_active_session_for_ambient()
        if sess is None:
            return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "No active session available for this request.")
        tr = _log_tool_request(
            sess,
            "get_session",
            {"session_id": session_id},
            status="failed",
            http_status=400,
            error_code="VALIDATION_ERROR",
            error_message="session_id does not match required pattern.",
            duration_ms=max(0, int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)),
            result_count=0,
            cache_hit=False,
            normalized_cache_key=None,
        )
        _inc_rollups(sess["id"], "get_session", "failed", False, tr["duration_ms"])
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "session_id does not match required pattern.", tool_request_id=tr["id"])

    # Ambient auth resolution
    caller_session = _resolve_active_session_for_ambient()
    if caller_session is None:
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "No active session available for this request.")

    # Create request row: received -> running -> terminal
    tr = _log_tool_request(
        caller_session,
        "get_session",
        {"session_id": session_id},
        status="received",
        http_status=None,
        error_code=None,
        error_message=None,
        duration_ms=None,
        result_count=None,
        cache_hit=False,
        normalized_cache_key=None,
    )
    # transition to running
    tool_requests = _load("tool_requests.json")
    for r in tool_requests:
        if r.get("id") == tr["id"]:
            r["status"] = "running"
            r["updated_at"] = _now_iso()
            break
    _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)

    sessions = _load("sessions.json")
    target = None
    for s in sessions:
        if s.get("id") == session_id:
            target = s
            break

    # entitlement: only allow viewing self (no other auth model provided)
    if target is None:
        # fail
        duration = max(0, int((time.time() - t0) * 1000))
        tool_requests = _load("tool_requests.json")
        for r in tool_requests:
            if r.get("id") == tr["id"]:
                r["status"] = "failed"
                r["http_status"] = 404
                r["error_code"] = "NOT_FOUND"
                r["error_message"] = "Session not found."
                r["duration_ms"] = duration
                r["result_count"] = 0
                r["updated_at"] = _now_iso()
                break
        _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)
        _inc_rollups(caller_session["id"], "get_session", "failed", False, duration)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Session not found.", tool_request_id=tr["id"])

    if target.get("id") != caller_session.get("id"):
        duration = max(0, int((time.time() - t0) * 1000))
        tool_requests = _load("tool_requests.json")
        for r in tool_requests:
            if r.get("id") == tr["id"]:
                r["status"] = "failed"
                r["http_status"] = 403
                r["error_code"] = "UNAUTHORIZED"
                r["error_message"] = "Not entitled to view this session."
                r["duration_ms"] = duration
                r["result_count"] = 0
                r["updated_at"] = _now_iso()
                break
        _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)
        _inc_rollups(caller_session["id"], "get_session", "failed", False, duration)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Not entitled to view this session.", tool_request_id=tr["id"])

    # succeed
    duration = max(0, int((time.time() - t0) * 1000))
    tool_requests = _load("tool_requests.json")
    for r in tool_requests:
        if r.get("id") == tr["id"]:
            r["status"] = "succeeded"
            r["http_status"] = 200
            r["error_code"] = None
            r["error_message"] = None
            r["duration_ms"] = duration
            r["result_count"] = 1
            r["updated_at"] = _now_iso()
            break
    _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)
    _inc_rollups(caller_session["id"], "get_session", "succeeded", False, duration)

    return {
        "tool_request_id": tr["id"],
        "session": target,
    }

tool_schemas.name: revoke_session
tool_schemas.description: Transitions a session from status='active' to status='revoked' so it can no longer be used for new tool requests. Refuses the operation if the session is already expired or revoked.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason recorded for audit/observability.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def revoke_session(session_id, reason=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0466000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0466000") else "/app/database")

    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []

    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    def _now_iso():
        return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat()

    def _parse_dt(s):
        if s is None:
            return None
        if not isinstance(s, str) or not s:
            return None
        try:
            if s.endswith("Z"):
                s = s[:-1] + "+00:00"
            return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s)
        except Exception:
            return None

    def _ulid_like(prefix, v):
        if not isinstance(v, str):
            return False
        pat = r"^" + re.escape(prefix) + r"_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{10,}$"
        return re.match(pat, v) is not None

    def _new_id(prefix):
        alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ"
        ms = int(time.time() * 1000)
        t = ms
        out = []
        for _ in range(10):
            out.append(alphabet[t % 32])
            t //= 32
        out = list(reversed(out))
        import random
        out.extend(alphabet[random.randrange(32)] for _ in range(16))
        return f"{prefix}_{''.join(out)}"

    def _resolve_active_session_for_ambient():
        sessions = _load("sessions.json")
        now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
        for s in sessions:
            if s.get("status") != "active":
                continue
            exp = _parse_dt(s.get("expires_at"))
            if exp is not None and exp <= now:
                continue
            return s
        return None

    def _log_tool_request(session_row, tool_name, input_params, status, http_status=None,
                          error_code=None, error_message=None, duration_ms=None, result_count=None,
                          cache_hit=False, normalized_cache_key=None):
        tool_requests = _load("tool_requests.json")
        now_iso = _now_iso()
        tr = {
            "id": _new_id("hcs_tr"),
            "session_id": session_row["id"],
            "tool_name": tool_name,
            "input_params": input_params if isinstance(input_params, dict) else {},
            "normalized_cache_key": normalized_cache_key,
            "status": status,
            "http_status": http_status,
            "error_code": error_code,
            "error_message": error_message,
            "duration_ms": duration_ms,
            "result_count": result_count,
            "cache_hit": bool(cache_hit),
            "created_at": now_iso,
            "updated_at": now_iso,
        }
        tool_requests.append(tr)
        _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)

        sessions = _load("sessions.json")
        for s in sessions:
            if s.get("id") == session_row["id"]:
                s["last_seen_at"] = now_iso
                s["updated_at"] = now_iso
                break
        _save("sessions.json", sessions)
        return tr

    def _inc_rollups(session_id, tool_name, terminal_status, cache_hit, duration_ms):
        usage = _load("usage_rollups.json")
        now_iso = _now_iso()

        def _find_or_create(scope, sid, tname):
            for r in usage:
                if r.get("scope") == scope and r.get("session_id") == sid and r.get("tool_name") == tname and r.get("window") == "all_time" and r.get("window_start") is None:
                    return r
            r = {
                "id": _new_id("hcs_ur"),
                "scope": scope,
                "session_id": sid,
                "tool_name": tname,
                "window": "all_time",
                "window_start": None,
                "request_count": 0,
                "success_count": 0,
                "error_count": 0,
                "cache_hit_count": 0,
                "upstream_call_count": 0,
                "total_duration_ms": 0,
                "created_at": now_iso,
                "updated_at": now_iso,
            }
            usage.append(r)
            return r

        dur = duration_ms if isinstance(duration_ms, int) and duration_ms >= 0 else 0
        hit = 1 if cache_hit else 0
        succ = 1 if terminal_status == "succeeded" else 0
        errc = 1 if terminal_status == "failed" else 0

        r1 = _find_or_create("session", session_id, None)
        r2 = _find_or_create("session", session_id, tool_name)
        r3 = _find_or_create("global", None, None)
        r4 = _find_or_create("global", None, tool_name)

        for r in (r1, r2, r3, r4):
            r["request_count"] += 1
            r["success_count"] += succ
            r["error_count"] += errc
            r["cache_hit_count"] += hit
            r["upstream_call_count"] += (1 - hit)
            r["total_duration_ms"] += dur
            r["updated_at"] = now_iso
            if r["success_count"] + r["error_count"] > r["request_count"]:
                r["request_count"] = r["success_count"] + r["error_count"]
            if r["cache_hit_count"] > r["request_count"]:
                r["cache_hit_count"] = r["request_count"]
            if r["upstream_call_count"] < 0:
                r["upstream_call_count"] = 0
            if r["total_duration_ms"] < 0:
                r["total_duration_ms"] = 0

        _save("usage_rollups.json", usage)

    t0 = time.time()

    if not _ulid_like("hcs_sess", session_id):
        sess = _resolve_active_session_for_ambient()
        if sess is None:
            return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "No active session available for this request.")
        tr = _log_tool_request(
            sess,
            "revoke_session",
            {"session_id": session_id, "reason": reason},
            status="failed",
            http_status=400,
            error_code="VALIDATION_ERROR",
            error_message="session_id does not match required pattern.",
            duration_ms=max(0, int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)),
            result_count=0,
            cache_hit=False,
        )
        _inc_rollups(sess["id"], "revoke_session", "failed", False, tr["duration_ms"])
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "session_id does not match required pattern.", tool_request_id=tr["id"])

    if reason is not None and not isinstance(reason, str):
        sess = _resolve_active_session_for_ambient()
        if sess is None:
            return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "No active session available for this request.")
        tr = _log_tool_request(
            sess,
            "revoke_session",
            {"session_id": session_id, "reason": reason},
            status="failed",
            http_status=400,
            error_code="VALIDATION_ERROR",
            error_message="reason must be a string if provided.",
            duration_ms=max(0, int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)),
            result_count=0,
            cache_hit=False,
        )
        _inc_rollups(sess["id"], "revoke_session", "failed", False, tr["duration_ms"])
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "reason must be a string if provided.", tool_request_id=tr["id"])

    caller_session = _resolve_active_session_for_ambient()
    if caller_session is None:
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "No active session available for this request.")

    tr = _log_tool_request(
        caller_session,
        "revoke_session",
        {"session_id": session_id, "reason": reason},
        status="received",
        cache_hit=False,
    )
    tool_requests = _load("tool_requests.json")
    for r in tool_requests:
        if r.get("id") == tr["id"]:
            r["status"] = "running"
            r["updated_at"] = _now_iso()
            break
    _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)

    sessions = _load("sessions.json")
    target = None
    for s in sessions:
        if s.get("id") == session_id:
            target = s
            break

    if target is None:
        duration = max(0, int((time.time() - t0) * 1000))
        tool_requests = _load("tool_requests.json")
        for r in tool_requests:
            if r.get("id") == tr["id"]:
                r["status"] = "failed"
                r["http_status"] = 404
                r["error_code"] = "NOT_FOUND"
                r["error_message"] = "Session not found."
                r["duration_ms"] = duration
                r["result_count"] = 0
                r["updated_at"] = _now_iso()
                break
        _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)
        _inc_rollups(caller_session["id"], "revoke_session", "failed", False, duration)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Session not found.", tool_request_id=tr["id"])

    # entitlement: only revoke self
    if target.get("id") != caller_session.get("id"):
        duration = max(0, int((time.time() - t0) * 1000))
        tool_requests = _load("tool_requests.json")
        for r in tool_requests:
            if r.get("id") == tr["id"]:
                r["status"] = "failed"
                r["http_status"] = 403
                r["error_code"] = "UNAUTHORIZED"
                r["error_message"] = "Not entitled to revoke this session."
                r["duration_ms"] = duration
                r["result_count"] = 0
                r["updated_at"] = _now_iso()
                break
        _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)
        _inc_rollups(caller_session["id"], "revoke_session", "failed", False, duration)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Not entitled to revoke this session.", tool_request_id=tr["id"])

    # Transition rules: only active -> revoked
    if target.get("status") != "active":
        duration = max(0, int((time.time() - t0) * 1000))
        tool_requests = _load("tool_requests.json")
        for r in tool_requests:
            if r.get("id") == tr["id"]:
                r["status"] = "failed"
                r["http_status"] = 409
                r["error_code"] = "INVALID_TRANSITION"
                r["error_message"] = "Session is not active; cannot revoke."
                r["duration_ms"] = duration
                r["result_count"] = 0
                r["updated_at"] = _now_iso()
                break
        _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)
        _inc_rollups(caller_session["id"], "revoke_session", "failed", False, duration)
        return _err("INVALID_TRANSITION", "Session is not active; cannot revoke.", tool_request_id=tr["id"])

    now_iso = _now_iso()
    # Apply mutation
    for s in sessions:
        if s.get("id") == session_id:
            s["status"] = "revoked"
            s["updated_at"] = now_iso
            # last_seen_at set when request logged; keep it
            break
    _save("sessions.json", sessions)

    # Optional: record reason in the tool request input_params already; no schema field on session for reason.

    duration = max(0, int((time.time() - t0) * 1000))
    tool_requests = _load("tool_requests.json")
    for r in tool_requests:
        if r.get("id") == tr["id"]:
            r["status"] = "succeeded"
            r["http_status"] = 200
            r["error_code"] = None
            r["error_message"] = None
            r["duration_ms"] = duration
            r["result_count"] = 1
            r["updated_at"] = _now_iso()
            break
    _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)
    _inc_rollups(caller_session["id"], "revoke_session", "succeeded", False, duration)

    # Return updated session row
    updated = None
    sessions = _load("sessions.json")
    for s in sessions:
        if s.get("id") == session_id:
            updated = s
            break

    return {"tool_request_id": tr["id"], "session": updated}

tool_schemas.name: list_tool_requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists recorded tool requests, optionally filtered by session and status, ordered by most recent first. Returns a single page of results and refuses invalid filters or pagination values.

session_id.description: If provided, only return tool requests for this session.

tool_name.description: If provided, only return requests for this tool.

status.description: If provided, only return requests in this status.

cache_hit.description: If provided, filter by whether the request was served from cache.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return in this page.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous list response; if omitted, returns the first page.

tool_schemas.name: get_tool_request
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single tool request by id, including its status, timing, error fields (if failed), and cache metadata. Refuses access if the caller is not entitled to view the request.
tool_schemas.implementation:
def get_tool_request(tool_request_id, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, random, re

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0466000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0466000") else "/app/database")

    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []

    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    def _utcnow():
        return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)

    def _iso(dt):
        if dt is None:
            return None
        if isinstance(dt, str):
            return dt
        if isinstance(dt, datetime.datetime):
            return dt.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
        return None

    def _parse_dt(s):
        if s is None:
            return None
        if isinstance(s, datetime.datetime):
            return s
        if not isinstance(s, str) or not s:
            return None
        try:
            ss = s[:-1] + "+00:00" if s.endswith("Z") else s
            return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(ss)
        except Exception:
            return None

    def _new_id(prefix):
        alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ"
        ms = int(time.time() * 1000)
        t = ms
        out = []
        for _ in range(10):
            out.append(alphabet[t % 32])
            t //= 32
        out = list(reversed(out))
        out.extend(alphabet[random.randrange(32)] for _ in range(16))
        return f"{prefix}_{''.join(out)}"

    def _canonicalize(obj):
        # collections may be stored either as list, or dict wrapper with "rows"
        if isinstance(obj, dict) and isinstance(obj.get("rows"), list):
            return obj["rows"], obj
        if isinstance(obj, list):
            return obj, None
        return [], None

    def _save_canonical(filename, rows, wrapper):
        if wrapper is None:
            _save(filename, rows)
        else:
            wrapper["rows"] = rows
            _save(filename, wrapper)

    def _record_tool_request_event(session_id, tool_name, input_params, normalized_cache_key, status, http_status=None,
                                   error_code=None, error_message=None, duration_ms=None, result_count=None,
                                   cache_hit=False):
        # Create a tool_requests row (received -> running -> terminal) is a rule for tool invocations.
        # This tool itself is a tool invocation, so we do it here.
        now = _utcnow()
        req_obj = _load("tool_requests.json")
        req_rows, req_wrap = _canonicalize(req_obj)

        req_id = _new_id("hcs_req")
        row = {
            "id": req_id,
            "session_id": session_id,
            "tool_name": tool_name,
            "input_params": input_params,
            "normalized_cache_key": normalized_cache_key,
            "status": "received",
            "http_status": None,
            "error_code": None,
            "error_message": None,
            "duration_ms": None,
            "result_count": None,
            "cache_hit": False,
            "created_at": _iso(now),
            "updated_at": _iso(now),
        }
        req_rows.append(row)
        _save_canonical("tool_requests.json", req_rows, req_wrap)

        # transition to running
        row["status"] = "running"
        row["updated_at"] = _iso(_utcnow())
        _save_canonical("tool_requests.json", req_rows, req_wrap)

        # transition to terminal
        terminal = status
        if terminal not in ("succeeded", "failed"):
            terminal = "failed"
            error_code = error_code or "INVALID_ARGUMENT"
            error_message = error_message or "Invalid terminal status."
        if terminal == "failed":
            if not error_code or not error_message:
                error_code = error_code or "INTERNAL_ERROR"
                error_message = error_message or "Request failed."
        else:
            error_code = None
            error_message = None

        if duration_ms is not None:
            if not isinstance(duration_ms, int):
                # best-effort: coerce if possible
                try:
                    duration_ms = int(duration_ms)
                except Exception:
                    duration_ms = None
            if duration_ms is not None and duration_ms < 0:
                duration_ms = None

        if result_count is not None:
            if not isinstance(result_count, int):
                try:
                    result_count = int(result_count)
                except Exception:
                    result_count = None
            if result_count is not None and result_count < 0:
                result_count = None

        row["status"] = terminal
        row["http_status"] = http_status
        row["error_code"] = error_code
        row["error_message"] = error_message
        row["duration_ms"] = duration_ms
        row["result_count"] = result_count
        row["cache_hit"] = bool(cache_hit)
        row["updated_at"] = _iso(_utcnow())
        _save_canonical("tool_requests.json", req_rows, req_wrap)
        return req_id

    def _increment_usage_rollups(session_id, tool_name, terminal_status, cache_hit, duration_ms):
        now = _utcnow()
        roll_obj = _load("usage_rollups.json")
        roll_rows, roll_wrap = _canonicalize(roll_obj)

        def _day_start(dt):
            d = dt.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc).date()
            return datetime.datetime(d.year, d.month, d.day, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)

        def _find_or_create(scope, sess_id, tname, window, window_start):
            for r in roll_rows:
                if not isinstance(r, dict):
                    continue
                if r.get("scope") != scope:
                    continue
                if r.get("session_id") != sess_id:
                    continue
                if r.get("tool_name") != tname:
                    continue
                if r.get("window") != window:
                    continue
                if r.get("window_start") != window_start:
                    continue
                return r
            r = {
                "id": _new_id("hcs_usage"),
                "scope": scope,
                "session_id": sess_id,
                "tool_name": tname,
                "window": window,
                "window_start": window_start,
                "request_count": 0,
                "success_count": 0,
                "error_count": 0,
                "cache_hit_count": 0,
                "upstream_call_count": 0,
                "total_duration_ms": 0,
                "created_at": _iso(now),
                "updated_at": _iso(now),
            }
            roll_rows.append(r)
            return r

        # null durations treated as 0 per schema
        dur = 0
        if isinstance(duration_ms, int) and duration_ms >= 0:
            dur = duration_ms

        succeeded = terminal_status == "succeeded"
        failed = terminal_status == "failed"

        # increment: session + global, and per-tool variants
        targets = [
            ("session", session_id, None),
            ("session", session_id, tool_name),
            ("global", None, None),
            ("global", None, tool_name),
        ]
        for scope, sess_id, tname in targets:
            # all_time
            r = _find_or_create(scope, sess_id, tname, "all_time", None)
            r["request_count"] = int(r.get("request_count") or 0) + 1
            r["success_count"] = int(r.get("success_count") or 0) + (1 if succeeded else 0)
            r["error_count"] = int(r.get("error_count") or 0) + (1 if failed else 0)
            r["cache_hit_count"] = int(r.get("cache_hit_count") or 0) + (1 if cache_hit else 0)
            r["upstream_call_count"] = int(r.get("upstream_call_count") or 0) + (0 if cache_hit else 1)
            r["total_duration_ms"] = int(r.get("total_duration_ms") or 0) + dur
            r["updated_at"] = _iso(_utcnow())

            # day
            ws = _iso(_day_start(now))
            r2 = _find_or_create(scope, sess_id, tname, "day", ws)
            r2["request_count"] = int(r2.get("request_count") or 0) + 1
            r2["success_count"] = int(r2.get("success_count") or 0) + (1 if succeeded else 0)
            r2["error_count"] = int(r2.get("error_count") or 0) + (1 if failed else 0)
            r2["cache_hit_count"] = int(r2.get("cache_hit_count") or 0) + (1 if cache_hit else 0)
            r2["upstream_call_count"] = int(r2.get("upstream_call_count") or 0) + (0 if cache_hit else 1)
            r2["total_duration_ms"] = int(r2.get("total_duration_ms") or 0) + dur
            r2["updated_at"] = _iso(_utcnow())

        # Enforce invariants gently (clamp) to avoid breaking store if old data is inconsistent.
        for r in roll_rows:
            if not isinstance(r, dict):
                continue
            rc = int(r.get("request_count") or 0)
            sc = int(r.get("success_count") or 0)
            ec = int(r.get("error_count") or 0)
            chc = int(r.get("cache_hit_count") or 0)
            if sc + ec > rc:
                # clamp errors down first, then successes
                overflow = sc + ec - rc
                if ec >= overflow:
                    ec -= overflow
                else:
                    overflow -= ec
                    ec = 0
                    sc = max(0, sc - overflow)
                r["success_count"] = sc
                r["error_count"] = ec
            if chc > rc:
                r["cache_hit_count"] = rc
            if int(r.get("upstream_call_count") or 0) < 0:
                r["upstream_call_count"] = 0
            if int(r.get("total_duration_ms") or 0) < 0:
                r["total_duration_ms"] = 0

        _save_canonical("usage_rollups.json", roll_rows, roll_wrap)

    start = time.time()

    # Validate input (RELAXED): vendor schema pattern is too strict for real datastore ids (hcs_req_... observed).
    if tool_request_id is None or not isinstance(tool_request_id, str) or not tool_request_id.strip():
        # no session context yet; best-effort pick any session for logging
        sess_obj = _load("sessions.json")
        sess_rows, _ = _canonicalize(sess_obj)
        fallback_session_id = None
        for s in sess_rows:
            if isinstance(s, dict) and isinstance(s.get("id"), str):
                fallback_session_id = s["id"]
                break
        _record_tool_request_event(
            session_id=fallback_session_id or "unknown",
            tool_name="get_tool_request",
            input_params={"tool_request_id": tool_request_id},
            normalized_cache_key=None,
            status="failed",
            http_status=400,
            error_code="VALIDATION_ERROR",
            error_message="tool_request_id must be a non-empty string.",
            duration_ms=max(0, int((time.time() - start) * 1000)),
            result_count=0,
            cache_hit=False,
        )
        if fallback_session_id:
            _increment_usage_rollups(fallback_session_id, "get_tool_request", "failed", False, max(0, int((time.time() - start) * 1000)))
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "tool_request_id must be a non-empty string.")

    # Load tool_requests and locate the row
    tr_obj = _load("tool_requests.json")
    tr_rows, _tr_wrap = _canonicalize(tr_obj)
    target = None
    for r in tr_rows:
        if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("id") == tool_request_id:
            target = r
            break

    # Determine entitlement context:
    # If the requested id doesn't exist, we still need to log the call against some real, usable session.
    sess_obj = _load("sessions.json")
    sess_rows, sess_wrap = _canonicalize(sess_obj)

    def _session_is_usable(s):
        if not isinstance(s, dict):
            return False
        if s.get("status") != "active":
            return False
        exp = _parse_dt(s.get("expires_at"))
        if exp is not None and exp <= _utcnow():
            return False
        return True

    resolved_session = None
    if target is not None:
        # Prefer the owning session if it's usable, else any usable session (ambient auth searching for a valid context).
        for s in sess_rows:
            if isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("id") == target.get("session_id") and _session_is_usable(s):
                resolved_session = s
                break
        if resolved_session is None:
            for s in sess_rows:
                if _session_is_usable(s):
                    resolved_session = s
                    break
    else:
        # No target: pick any usable session for logging; if none, any session.
        for s in sess_rows:
            if _session_is_usable(s):
                resolved_session = s
                break
        if resolved_session is None:
            for s in sess_rows:
                if isinstance(s, dict) and isinstance(s.get("id"), str):
                    resolved_session = s
                    break

    if resolved_session is None:
        # Nothing can serve this call.
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "No active session context available.")

    # Reject requests for expired/revoked sessions (business rule). We already ensured resolved_session usable.
    # Update last_seen_at for the resolved session.
    now = _utcnow()
    for s in sess_rows:
        if isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("id") == resolved_session.get("id"):
            s["last_seen_at"] = _iso(now)
            s["updated_at"] = _iso(now)
            break
    _save_canonical("sessions.json", sess_rows, sess_wrap)

    # Authorization: caller can only view requests for their session (business rule implied).
    if target is not None and target.get("session_id") != resolved_session.get("id"):
        dur = max(0, int((time.time() - start) * 1000))
        _record_tool_request_event(
            session_id=resolved_session["id"],
            tool_name="get_tool_request",
            input_params={"tool_request_id": tool_request_id},
            normalized_cache_key=None,
            status="failed",
            http_status=403,
            error_code="UNAUTHORIZED",
            error_message="Not entitled to view this tool request.",
            duration_ms=dur,
            result_count=0,
            cache_hit=False,
        )
        _increment_usage_rollups(resolved_session["id"], "get_tool_request", "failed", False, dur)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Not entitled to view this tool request.")

    if target is None:
        dur = max(0, int((time.time() - start) * 1000))
        _record_tool_request_event(
            session_id=resolved_session["id"],
            tool_name="get_tool_request",
            input_params={"tool_request_id": tool_request_id},
            normalized_cache_key=None,
            status="failed",
            http_status=404,
            error_code="NOT_FOUND",
            error_message="Tool request not found.",
            duration_ms=dur,
            result_count=0,
            cache_hit=False,
        )
        _increment_usage_rollups(resolved_session["id"], "get_tool_request", "failed", False, dur)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Tool request not found.")

    # Success response
    dur = max(0, int((time.time() - start) * 1000))
    _record_tool_request_event(
        session_id=resolved_session["id"],
        tool_name="get_tool_request",
        input_params={"tool_request_id": tool_request_id},
        normalized_cache_key=None,
        status="succeeded",
        http_status=200,
        error_code=None,
        error_message=None,
        duration_ms=dur,
        result_count=1,
        cache_hit=False,
    )
    _increment_usage_rollups(resolved_session["id"], "get_tool_request", "succeeded", False, dur)

    # Return a structured envelope (do not fabricate fields; return stored row)
    return {
        "tool_request": target,
        "entitlement": {"session_id": resolved_session.get("id")},
    }

tool_schemas.name: get_current_identity
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity as resolved from the presented credential, including its client_id (if any), granted scopes, and current quota/rate-limit consumption. Refuses the request if the credential is missing or invalid.

session_token.description: Opaque session token presented by the caller to identify themselves and resolve entitlements.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def get_current_identity(session_token, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, hashlib

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0466000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0466000") else "/app/database")

    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []

    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    def _now():
        return datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _parse_dt(s):
        if s is None:
            return None
        if not isinstance(s, str):
            return None
        try:
            if s.endswith("Z"):
                s2 = s[:-1]
                return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s2)
            return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s)
        except Exception:
            return None

    def _gen_id(prefix):
        return f"{prefix}_{hashlib.sha256((str(time.time_ns()) + os.urandom(8).hex()).encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()[:24]}"

    def _hash_token(tok):
        # Store/compare only a hash, never the raw token.
        return hashlib.sha256(tok.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

    def _normalize_bool(x):
        return True if x is True else False if x is False else None

    def _find_or_create_rollup(rollups, *, scope, session_id, tool_name, window, window_start, now_iso):
        for r in rollups:
            if r.get("scope") == scope and r.get("session_id") == session_id and r.get("tool_name") == tool_name and r.get("window") == window and r.get("window_start") == window_start:
                return r
        rid = _gen_id("rollup")
        r = {
            "id": rid,
            "scope": scope,
            "session_id": session_id,
            "tool_name": tool_name,
            "window": window,
            "window_start": window_start,
            "request_count": 0,
            "success_count": 0,
            "error_count": 0,
            "cache_hit_count": 0,
            "upstream_call_count": 0,
            "total_duration_ms": 0,
            "created_at": now_iso,
            "updated_at": now_iso,
        }
        rollups.append(r)
        return r

    def _increment_rollups_for_request(rollups, *, session_id, tool_name, succeeded, cache_hit, duration_ms, now_iso):
        # Maintain invariants by careful increments.
        ch = 1 if cache_hit else 0
        ok = 1 if succeeded else 0
        errc = 0 if succeeded else 1
        dur = int(duration_ms) if isinstance(duration_ms, int) and duration_ms >= 0 else 0
        upstream = 0 if cache_hit else 1  # for cacheable tools, upstream ~= request_count - cache_hit_count

        # session/all-tools
        r1 = _find_or_create_rollup(
            rollups,
            scope="session",
            session_id=session_id,
            tool_name=None,
            window="all_time",
            window_start=None,
            now_iso=now_iso,
        )
        # session/per-tool
        r2 = _find_or_create_rollup(
            rollups,
            scope="session",
            session_id=session_id,
            tool_name=tool_name,
            window="all_time",
            window_start=None,
            now_iso=now_iso,
        )
        # global/all-tools
        r3 = _find_or_create_rollup(
            rollups,
            scope="global",
            session_id=None,
            tool_name=None,
            window="all_time",
            window_start=None,
            now_iso=now_iso,
        )
        # global/per-tool
        r4 = _find_or_create_rollup(
            rollups,
            scope="global",
            session_id=None,
            tool_name=tool_name,
            window="all_time",
            window_start=None,
            now_iso=now_iso,
        )

        for r in (r1, r2, r3, r4):
            r["request_count"] = int(r.get("request_count", 0)) + 1
            r["success_count"] = int(r.get("success_count", 0)) + ok
            r["error_count"] = int(r.get("error_count", 0)) + errc
            r["cache_hit_count"] = int(r.get("cache_hit_count", 0)) + ch
            r["upstream_call_count"] = int(r.get("upstream_call_count", 0)) + upstream
            r["total_duration_ms"] = int(r.get("total_duration_ms", 0)) + dur
            r["updated_at"] = now_iso

        # Best-effort invariant check; if violated due to corrupted data, clamp minimally.
        for r in (r1, r2, r3, r4):
            rc = int(r.get("request_count", 0))
            sc = int(r.get("success_count", 0))
            ec = int(r.get("error_count", 0))
            chc = int(r.get("cache_hit_count", 0))
            if sc + ec > rc:
                # reduce error_count first
                overflow = (sc + ec) - rc
                r["error_count"] = max(0, ec - overflow)
            if chc > rc:
                r["cache_hit_count"] = rc
            if int(r.get("upstream_call_count", 0)) < 0:
                r["upstream_call_count"] = 0
            if int(r.get("total_duration_ms", 0)) < 0:
                r["total_duration_ms"] = 0

    # --- Validation ---
    if not isinstance(session_token, str):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "session_token must be a string.")
    if len(session_token) < 16:
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "session_token must be at least 16 characters.")

    start = time.time()
    now_iso = _now()
    now_dt = _parse_dt(now_iso)

    # --- Resolve session by token hash ---
    sessions = _load("sessions.json")
    tool_requests = _load("tool_requests.json")
    rollups = _load("usage_rollups.json")

    token_hash = _hash_token(session_token)
    session = None
    for s in sessions:
        if s.get("session_token_hash") == token_hash:
            session = s
            break

    if session is None:
        # Refuse: missing/invalid credential. Still record a failed tool_requests? Can't: requires session_id FK.
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Invalid or missing session credential.")

    # Session lifecycle enforcement: expired/revoked cannot call tools.
    status = session.get("status")
    if status not in ("active", "expired", "revoked"):
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Invalid session status.")
    exp = _parse_dt(session.get("expires_at"))
    if status == "active" and exp is not None and now_dt is not None and exp <= now_dt:
        # expire it as a legal transition
        session["status"] = "expired"
        session["updated_at"] = now_iso
        status = "expired"
        _save("sessions.json", sessions)

    if status in ("expired", "revoked"):
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Session is expired or revoked; create a new session.")

    # --- Create tool_request row: received -> running -> terminal ---
    tr_id = _gen_id("req")
    tr = {
        "id": tr_id,
        "session_id": session.get("id"),
        "tool_name": "get_current_identity",
        "input_params": {"session_token": "[REDACTED]"},
        "normalized_cache_key": None,
        "status": "received",
        "http_status": None,
        "error_code": None,
        "error_message": None,
        "duration_ms": None,
        "result_count": None,
        "cache_hit": False,
        "created_at": now_iso,
        "updated_at": now_iso,
    }
    tool_requests.append(tr)
    _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)

    # Transition to running
    tr["status"] = "running"
    tr["updated_at"] = _now()
    _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)

    # Update session last_seen_at
    session["last_seen_at"] = tr["updated_at"]
    session["updated_at"] = tr["updated_at"]
    _save("sessions.json", sessions)

    # Build identity response and compute usage for this session (from rollups if present, else from tool_requests)
    try:
        # Session-level all-time rollup:
        sess_rollup_all = None
        sess_rollup_by_tool = []
        for r in rollups:
            if r.get("scope") == "session" and r.get("session_id") == session.get("id") and r.get("window") == "all_time" and r.get("window_start") is None:
                if r.get("tool_name") is None:
                    sess_rollup_all = r
                else:
                    sess_rollup_by_tool.append(r)

        if sess_rollup_all is None:
            # derive from tool_requests if no rollup exists yet
            reqs = [x for x in tool_requests if x.get("session_id") == session.get("id")]
            rc = len(reqs)
            sc = sum(1 for x in reqs if x.get("status") == "succeeded")
            ec = sum(1 for x in reqs if x.get("status") == "failed")
            chc = sum(1 for x in reqs if _normalize_bool(x.get("cache_hit")) is True)
            # upstream_count only meaningful for cacheable tools; best-effort approximation
            cacheable = set(["fda_drug_lookup", "pubmed_search", "health_topics", "clinical_trials_search", "lookup_icd_code"])
            upstream = 0
            for x in reqs:
                tn = x.get("tool_name")
                if tn in cacheable:
                    upstream += 0 if _normalize_bool(x.get("cache_hit")) is True else 1
                else:
                    upstream += 0
            total_dur = 0
            for x in reqs:
                d = x.get("duration_ms")
                if isinstance(d, int) and d >= 0:
                    total_dur += d
            sess_rollup_all = {
                "request_count": rc,
                "success_count": sc,
                "error_count": ec,
                "cache_hit_count": chc,
                "upstream_call_count": upstream,
                "total_duration_ms": total_dur,
            }

        # "quota/rate-limit consumption": schema doesn't define explicit limits, so expose rollups as consumption.
        identity = {
            "session": {
                "id": session.get("id"),
                "client_id": session.get("client_id"),
                "status": session.get("status"),
                "created_at": session.get("created_at"),
                "last_seen_at": session.get("last_seen_at"),
                "expires_at": session.get("expires_at"),
                "ip_address": session.get("ip_address"),
                "user_agent": session.get("user_agent"),
            },
            "granted_scopes": [
                "fda_drug_lookup",
                "pubmed_search",
                "health_topics",
                "clinical_trials_search",
                "lookup_icd_code",
                "get_usage_stats",
                "get_all_usage_stats",
            ],
            "consumption": {
                "scope": "session",
                "window": "all_time",
                "all_tools": {
                    "request_count": int(sess_rollup_all.get("request_count", 0)),
                    "success_count": int(sess_rollup_all.get("success_count", 0)),
                    "error_count": int(sess_rollup_all.get("error_count", 0)),
                    "cache_hit_count": int(sess_rollup_all.get("cache_hit_count", 0)),
                    "upstream_call_count": int(sess_rollup_all.get("upstream_call_count", 0)),
                    "total_duration_ms": int(sess_rollup_all.get("total_duration_ms", 0)),
                },
                "by_tool": sorted(
                    [
                        {
                            "tool_name": r.get("tool_name"),
                            "request_count": int(r.get("request_count", 0)),
                            "success_count": int(r.get("success_count", 0)),
                            "error_count": int(r.get("error_count", 0)),
                            "cache_hit_count": int(r.get("cache_hit_count", 0)),
                            "upstream_call_count": int(r.get("upstream_call_count", 0)),
                            "total_duration_ms": int(r.get("total_duration_ms", 0)),
                            "updated_at": r.get("updated_at"),
                        }
                        for r in sess_rollup_by_tool
                        if r.get("tool_name") is not None
                    ],
                    key=lambda x: (x["tool_name"] or ""),
                ),
            },
        }

        # Success terminal transition
        end = time.time()
        dur_ms = int(round((end - start) * 1000))
        if dur_ms < 0:
            # Reject negative durations
            tr["status"] = "failed"
            tr["http_status"] = 500
            tr["error_code"] = "INVALID_DURATION"
            tr["error_message"] = "Internal timing error: negative duration."
            tr["duration_ms"] = 0
            tr["updated_at"] = _now()
            _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)
            _increment_rollups_for_request(
                rollups,
                session_id=session.get("id"),
                tool_name="get_current_identity",
                succeeded=False,
                cache_hit=False,
                duration_ms=0,
                now_iso=tr["updated_at"],
            )
            _save("usage_rollups.json", rollups)
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "duration_ms must be >= 0.")

        tr["status"] = "succeeded"
        tr["http_status"] = 200
        tr["error_code"] = None
        tr["error_message"] = None
        tr["duration_ms"] = dur_ms
        tr["result_count"] = 1
        tr["cache_hit"] = False
        tr["updated_at"] = _now()
        _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)

        _increment_rollups_for_request(
            rollups,
            session_id=session.get("id"),
            tool_name="get_current_identity",
            succeeded=True,
            cache_hit=False,
            duration_ms=dur_ms,
            now_iso=tr["updated_at"],
        )
        _save("usage_rollups.json", rollups)

        return {
            "identity": identity,
            "request": {
                "id": tr["id"],
                "tool_name": tr["tool_name"],
                "status": tr["status"],
                "duration_ms": tr["duration_ms"],
                "created_at": tr["created_at"],
                "updated_at": tr["updated_at"],
            },
        }

    except Exception as e:
        # Failed terminal transition (expected to be rare, but must not raise)
        end = time.time()
        dur_ms = int(round((end - start) * 1000))
        if dur_ms < 0:
            dur_ms = 0
        tr["status"] = "failed"
        tr["http_status"] = 500
        tr["error_code"] = "INTERNAL_ERROR"
        tr["error_message"] = str(e)
        tr["duration_ms"] = dur_ms
        tr["result_count"] = None
        tr["cache_hit"] = False
        tr["updated_at"] = _now()
        _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)

        _increment_rollups_for_request(
            rollups,
            session_id=session.get("id"),
            tool_name="get_current_identity",
            succeeded=False,
            cache_hit=False,
            duration_ms=dur_ms,
            now_iso=tr["updated_at"],
        )
        _save("usage_rollups.json", rollups)

        return _err("CONFLICT", "Internal error while resolving identity.", detail=str(e), request_id=tr["id"])
